address: Costa Rica 6038, Buenos Aires, C1414BTN, Argentina
bio: If you’re on the lookout for a restaurant focusing on “plant -based” cuisine, this eatery on the ground floor of the CasaSur boutique hotel in the Palermo Hollywood is definitely worth considering – a sensation enhanced by its bright façade in different tones of white, featuring striking circular perforations that create contrast and add light. Its elongated layout boasts a modern design, and includes a pleasant terrace teeming with vegetation to the rear. Here, the contemporary à la carte showcases vegetarian dishes made to share which add a strong element of surprise.
